text:
Jordan Grimmer-Tufik 
Hi Jordan, 
Thank you so very much for your reply.

Just to note - we're aware of the problem of him going abroad while our application is in process. He hasn't left the country at any time, which is also difficult but we are trying to do everything right.

I think he will continue going in there in person and he will also email them.

Do you think a lawyer could help at this point? They said they could file a complaint which would give them 30 days to respond. I think you are saying we could also do this ourselves with the same efficacy?
I think we would do a complaint if his next visit doesn't yield any results.

In the email, would it be too strong to suggest that if we don't get a response we will have no option but to file a complaint? Or is that too "threatening" and potentially harmful for us 😐

I was expecting it to be 4 months before we heard. Plus the war delayed things. But now I think we have waited too long.

Thanks again for your help 🙏🙏🙏
